findings.claim: pubSfrGetJpeg emits service 0x2009/cmd 0x100 and receives u16 handle, u16 blocks shifted by 7, and a count.
pvtScalarInfraIF uses DataflowInfra SendASync/ReceiveASync and copies a 0x170-byte response.
pubMmap opens /dev/mem, opens DMM extent, page-aligns it, and calls mmap with RW/shared arguments.
MmapLiveViewJpeg maps the u16 handle and releases prior mapping/unit.
free and close-and-free are distinct DMM release calls.
CameraSequence GetPreviewFrame waits for event 0x1e08 and returns SDCom vectors; no static edge to ISS/SFRA was found.
No ashmem reference or ashmem API call was found in the examined user-space libraries.
The SFRA JPEG handle proves neither raw/YC delivery nor any unresolved ObjCamera YC field.
The mapped DMM unit is loaned to ISS until explicit release; final ownership/refcount is not recovered.

delivery.producer_input: YC through internal SFRS EE/Rec pins
delivery.linux_payload: DMM unit handle u16 plus size rounded to 128-byte blocks
delivery.transfer: control request/reply followed by /dev/mem mmap; no pixel copy demonstrated in ISS
delivery.timing: after JPEG READY and on GET_JPEG request

unverified: JPEG exact length, validity, dimensions and metadata
safety: No original binary or Ghidra project modified; no camera connected or flashed; SilentShutter is not declared functional.
